factor_diagnostics.value_notes: Archival tags on young Pacific bluefin tuna reported preference for 14-20 °C water. A 2025 Northwestern Pacific study tagged three adult spawning fish and recorded temperatures from 16-32 °C during vertical movements, with substantial individual and day/night variation. This supports the configured 15-22 °C / 17-20 °C interval as broad context, but juvenile and adult data, Japanese/Northwestern Pacific locations, and spawning-season behavior are not a validated West Coast catch-response curve.
